_national.labelling: Moldova has four wine PGIs (IGP) for still, liqueur and sparkling wine: Codru, Ștefan Vodă, Valul lui Traian, plus the brandy PGI Divin. Specifications are approved by order under Law 57/2006 on vine and wine and Law 66/2008 on geographical indications; grapes, processing, ageing and bottling all within the PGI area for Codru.

src.title: Caiet de sarcini IGP "Codru" (ONVV / MAIA order 215 of 28.12.2011)
Caiet de sarcini IGP "Ștefan Vodă" (order 188 of 12.10.2011)

md-codru.varieties: Whites: Aligoté, Chardonnay, Fetească Albă, Fetească Regală, Floricica, Muscats (Frontignan, Ialoveni, Ottonel), Pinot Blanc, Pinot Gris, Riesling, Rkatsiteli, Sauvignon, Silvaner, Traminer. Reds: Cabernet Sauvignon, Cabernet Franc, Fetească Neagră, Gamay Fréaux, Malbec, Merlot, Pinot Noir, Rară Neagră, Saperavi, Syrah. Aromatic sparkling at least 50% Fetească Regală, Muscat or Traminer.
md-codru.min_alcohol: Grapes at least 175 g/l sugar (white, rosé), 180 g/l (red), 170 g/l (sparkling and liqueur base). Wine at least 11.0% (white, rosé), 11.5% (red), 10.0% (sparkling); liqueur wines (strong) 17 to 22%.
md-codru.max_yield: White and rosé 12 t/ha and 65 dal/t; red 10 t/ha and 60 dal/t; sparkling 13 t/ha and 62.5 dal/t; liqueur 15 t/ha and 68 dal/t.
md-codru.styles: White, rosé, red; liqueur (strong and dessert); sparkling, quality sparkling and quality aromatic sparkling.
md-codru.other: At least 2,500 vines/ha, irrigation only in drought years by authority decision, hand harvest (machines allowed for red and liqueur). Whole cycle incl. bottling inside the Codru area; sold bottled only.

src.title: Caiet de sarcini IGP "Codru" (ONVV / MAIA order 215 of 28.12.2011)

md-stefan-voda.varieties: Whites: Muscat Ottonel, Sauvignon, Chardonnay, Pinot Gris, Fetească Albă, Riesling, Aligoté, Rkatsiteli, Furmint, Pinot Blanc, Viognier. Reds: Cabernet Sauvignon, Cabernet Franc, Merlot, Pinot Noir, Malbec, Gamay Fréaux, Saperavi, Pinot Meunier, Fetească Neagră, Rară Neagră, Marselan, Syrah, Carmenère, Petit Verdot and others.
md-stefan-voda.min_alcohol: Grapes at least 175 g/l (white) and 180 g/l (red); wine at least 11.0% (white, rosé), 11.5% (red).
md-stefan-voda.max_yield: 12 t/ha (Cabernets, Muscat Ottonel, Sauvignon, Chardonnay, Traminer, Pinot Blanc, Viognier) or 15 t/ha (others); max 60 dal/t.
md-stefan-voda.ageing: Maturation at least 6 months (white) and 12 months (red), in barrique or larger casks; malolactic compulsory for reds.
md-stefan-voda.other: South-east Moldova near the Black Sea, about 10,000 ha; includes the Purcari area.
